judge.rationale: The candidate invents its own protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of the specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and interface names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It directly violates a core requirement by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `store.listFor` is missing rather than adding `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` and returning an error frame, and it completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config flag. Validation also fails the acceptance criteria by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of restricting `limit` to 1–200. Furthermore, it logs `error.message` on store failure (which the spec/reference avoids to prevent leaking driver credentials), leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository, and skips the required updates to `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`.
